balls.text: Dilshan finishes the innings on a high, slower ball bowled short and that's been slashed through point for four more
full toss and that's been helped on its way past the short fine leg fielder, poor ball under the circumstances
another slower one and he swung hard at that one, was too early into the shot, was hit on the shoulder, a single in the end
a slower one bowled short but too high is what the umpires think it is,went over his head, called a wide
slower one bowled full outside off, creamed but straight to deep cover for a single
two more, Dilshan runs to the danger end this time and makes it, through square leg for a couple of runs
launched over extra cover, AB calls for the second and makes it to the non-striker's end in time
AB is unstoppable, slower one dragged short and he sends that miles into the stands behind deep midwicket, this stand is worth 107 in under nine overs
half-century for AB, another one this IPL, got there in fortunate fashion, moved well across to scoop it over short fine, got a thick outside edge and it went past third man instead
powerfully struck, was the slower one, he picked it, was short, he picked the length early, he moved away a hint and bludgeoned it over long-on
slower one bowled short, pulled towards deep square leg on the bounce for a single
another full toss, on the pads this time and it was a hit-me ball that AB rues not punishing, played away straight to short fine, just the single
tried to scoop that full toss over short fine, got an inside edge onto the pads, just the single
called a no-ball but it might be a questionable call, AB came down the track to that one, was above the waist at the point of contact but he had charged out of the crease, pulled to square leg
more runs, poor ball, a full toss on the pads, Dilshan doesn't get a whole lot of bat on it but just about enough to earn four past short fine leg..in fact, it was leg-byes, clipped the pads
swings hard at that one, slower one and he tried to drag that over square leg, missed
slower one bowled short, whacked towards deep cover for a single
AB's looking dangerous, he is in some form, aiming for a yorker there but turns out to be a low full toss, reverse-paddled between point and short third man
thrashed, flat six over long-off, pitched up outside off, a length ball and it's been smashed
bowls htat full on middle, drives it towards long-on for a single
short ball bowled slow outside off, Dilshan has to reach out for it as he tried to cut, missed, called a wide
pitched up outside off and it's been slog-swept straight to deep midwicket, just the single
reverse-sweeps that one straight to short fine, another single
the googly bowled short outside off, cut straight to point but a single's taken
short outside off, four more, moves away and cuts that delicately through point for another boundary, Rajasthan have conceded far too may in the last few overs
slipped out of his hand, ends up being an above-the-waist no-ball that's smacked by Dilshan over short fine for a boundary
pitched up on the off, chipped through extra cover into the deep for a single
low full toss, swept down towards deep backward square leg for a single
nicely bowled, a touch quicker and it nips away to beat the outside edge as AB gets forward
chopped that slower one towards Cooper at point, quick single taken and it brings up Dilshan's half-century, a steady innings
slower one bowled short outside off, punched over extra cover, three more as Owais Shah at long-off has to move to his left and cut that off
slower one bowled short outside off, cracked towards deep cover
gift ball, full toss on middle and that's been dragged over square leg for a boundary, Bangalore are pushing on
Caught! By one of the players in the RCB dug-out, landed on a length and that was smacked over the bowler's head, and over long-off
de Villiers cashes in on some width, makes room and launches that over extra cover for a welcome four
fires that one in the blockhole on middle, Cooper appeals for lbw, the umpire reckoned he hit it but the replay didn't seem to suggest that, was struck in line as he tried to dig that out
chops that one into the off side, an easy single taken

run-out chance, short of a good length, chopped it just wide of the stumps and AB called for the single, had the keeper picked up cleanly and flipped it onto the stumps, it would have been a close call
was the slower one bowled full outside off, tried to heave that one over midwicket, missed
low full toss on middle, drives it straight down the ground to long-on for a single
pushed it full on middle and leg, drives it through midwicket, AB's quick and he completes the second comfortably
found the gap, superbly placed, short on middle and he had eyed his spot, pulled it between deep square leg and deep backward square leg
tossed up on the off, drives it wide of Hogg, dives to his right to save the single
the googly, short of a good length outside off, moved away to cut, it turned the other way and he missed
played towards point, that was a reverse-sweep, Pankaj mis-fielded it there, straightforward but he made a mess, then had to give chase but had conceded three
appeal for lbw, turned in and struck him on the back pad as he tried to play it into the off side, would have probably gone down leg
treated that gently, full toss on middle, paddled that to short fine, not above the waist according to the umpire
and another one, wasn't quite to the pitch but was committed to the shot and connected it well, charged down the track, took it from outside off and swung it over deep midwicket
finally, doles out a long hop and de Villiers steps back to deposit it over deep midwicket, pulled away for the first six of the innings, in the 13th over
comes down the track as he held that back, tidy spell so far this, was dropped into the leg side
walked across to that one and turns that behind square for a single
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and turns that towards midwicket for a single
beaten by the googly, tossed it up this time and Dilshan tried to open the face as it turned away, missed
wide down the leg side, spins down the leg side and beats the keeper as well, five runs given away
the ground-fielding has been horrible, Cooper again, runs in from long-on and misfields, they sneak a single and then two more as Cooper over-runs the ball

Hogg traps him in front, quicker through the air and bowled flat, and what's more it was the wrong'un, Gayle didn't spot it, got on the back foot to turn it square, misses and was struck on the pads in line with leg stump
tossed up on middle, chipped uppishly just wide of a diving extra cover for a couple of runs
the googly, comes down the track to that shortish delivery, it turns away from him, played through cover for a single
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it back to the bowler
nicely done again, short outside off and he moves back to drop it towards point as it turns away
beaten, sharp turn for Chandila away from Gayle, short of a good length and it spun away to beat the edge
short on the off, gets on the back foot and pulls it through square leg for a single
tossed up on the off, drills that one down the ground to long-on for a single
round the wicket, gets a stride out and pushes that one down the pitch
gets forward and defends that one back to the bowler
full toss and that's been timed well, drives that straight towards long-off for a single
played away into the deep on the off side for a single
sweeps that high and holes out, Hodge takes that one well at deep square leg, second catch of the day, went at that hard, tried the slog-sweep, got the top edge against the wrong'un
almost in the blockhole, bowled full and he dug it out into the leg side
short on the off this time, pulled wide of long-on, flatly, for a couple of runs, Cooper runs to his right and keeps them to a couple
starts with a short one on the leg side, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, defended off the back foot into the off side
was totally surprised by that slower one, cut back in and the extent of movement was what had him in a bit of trouble, caught him on the thigh
tries to repeat that shot, was the slower one on the pads, tried to scoop it again, ended up playing it wide of the keeper and he did well, diving to his left, to stop it
the ramp shot pays off, it's got him out once this IPL but this one worked, angled in and he had made up his mind, scooped it over short fine
sees him coming down the track, holds that one back, Dilshan tries to chop that one, misses
waits for that to come on and guides that behind point and in front of third man for a well-run couple
short outside off, guided that one down to third man for a single
moves away, short of a good length, tried to cut that away from his body, was beaten by the movement
shot off the pitch, sharp short ball and quick as well and Dilshan withdrew at just the right time, just went past the gloves
bowled that short outside off, chopped through point for a single
lucky but he'll take it, banged in short and he went for the pull, caught the glove and it went over the keeper for four more, was a good, quick bouncer
nicely struck, short and Agarwal stands tall to dispatch that over mid-off for a boundary
slower one bowled short outside off, that's been chopped straight to point
whips that one through midwicket for one more
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and defends that to extra cover
shortish on middle, turned away through square leg, Dilshan wants the second but it's not there to take
shortish on the off, rocks back and guides that straight towards gully
opens the face does Agarwal, running that one down to third man
thrashed, another short ball and Bangalore have regained some ground, pulled away hard through square leg for a boundary this time
would have gone down the leg side, Pankaj appeals, shuffled slightly to whip it over square leg but it would have gone down and struck him high as well
opens up, held it back did Pankaj, short outside off and that was dragged through midwicket for a welcome four
on target on middle, Dilshan pats it back down the pitch, the bowling's been good so far, they've given little away
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and turns it past midwicket for a single
short and wide, gets a thick edge down to third man as he tries to cut

dropped, Stuart Binny has split it, continuing the poor performance in the field, barring that catch by Hodge, pushed it full this time and he just drove loosely at that one, scooping it towards Binny at extra cover but he just couldn't hold on to a straightforward chance
back of a length outside off, nips away, fishes for that one and he misses
angling on the pads, tries to flick it square but is struck on the pads, they take another leg-bye

nice footwork from Cooper, dropped it down into the leg side, Cooper and Dilshan are involved in a race as Bangalore attempt a single, Cooper kicks the ball onto the stumps but Dilshan has made it well in time
hitting a short of a good length again, gets on the back foot and knocks it down solidly towards cover
short of a good length outside off, that shoots away to beat the outside edge, the keeper fumbles as well
short and wide, had to reach for that one, cut down through the in-field for a single into the deep
shortish outside off, cracked off the back foot towards deep point for a single

hasn't middled that, Kohli has holed out, lands on a good length, he dances down the track and lofts that high, was aiming to clear the extra cover boundary but ended up offering a catch to Hodge at deep cover, Hodge judged it well, in fact he ran across from deep point
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and pushes that to cover
on a good length outside off, reaches forward and pushes it to extra cover
gets that one to nip away, Kohli charges out of the track and tries to crack that over extra cover, misses
another single conceded, tossed up and it's driven straight to Cooper at mid-off, he fumbles and concedes a single
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and turns it through midwicket for a single
ooh, that appeared to stop on him just a bit, Kohli was committed to the punch, ended up just chipping it over the bowler's head for a single, landed safely
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it through midwicket for a single
tossed up and Dilshan senses a chance, dances down the track and launches that over mid-on for a comfortable boundary
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and punches it to extra cover, a single's not on offer there
angling in towards middle, drops that wide of midwicket, big yawning gap there and Kohli calls for the second, and gets it
nicely struck, short of a good length, gets on the back foot and just punches it over the in-field, over extra cover, for a boundary
on a good length and it's nipped away, Kohli is drawn into a shot off the front foot, misses as it moves away, beaten in fact
gets on the back foot and knocks that into the off side

horrible fielding in the deep, nerves for Chandila, short of a good length outside off, it's punched through point into the deep, Chandila runs across from third man and just misfields it, trying to pick it with one hand, rolls over for four
that one nipped away and kept a little low, got to the keeper on the second bounce, Kohli played that slightly away from his body and he missed
slightly short, gets back and punches it down the ground for a single to long-on
tossed up on middle, drives it straight down to deep midwicket for a couple of runs as the man in the deep runs across and cuts it off
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and punches that through midwicket for a single
tossed up on the off, really slow through the air, gets forward and drives it back to the bowler
gets forward and across and chips that wide of midwicket
a high-arm action, shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and punches it to the bowler
the match ends with a wicket, makes room and drives that straight to extra cover, Bangalore have won easily
bowled that full outside off, squeezed that through point into the deep for a couple
slower one again, gets an under-edge as he tries to clear the infield on the off side
slower one bowled short outside off, drags that through square leg for a single
full toss outside off, makes room and plays that down to third man for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, makes room and launches that over extra cover
slower one bowled short outside off, runs that down to third man for one more
aiming for the yorker, drives that down to long-off for a single
full outside off, makes room and drops it in front of point for a single
rose up from short of a good length, chipped in front of extra cover for a single
slower one and he didn't pick that, went after it a touch too early, missed
makes room and Zaheer chases him, dragged through square leg for a single
shortish outside off, cracked towards mid-off, just the single
short ball on the off, cut down towards point off the back foot, steals a quick single
mid-off is up and Binny hammers that short ball past the bowler and mid-off for a boundary
slower one bowled short, drags it wide of midwicket for a single
dropped that short outside off, run down to third man for a single

appeal for run-out, shortish outside off, goes for the cut, gets an inside edge just wide of the stumps, de Villiers runs forward , collects and under-arms a throw onto the stumps at the striker's end, the bat is just in, a fraction in, when the bails are dislodged, he's just made it. Though the ball made contact with the stumps when the batsman was still short, it popped up when he was just in. The third umpire is taking his time, and gives the benefit of the doubt to the batsman
slower one outside off, opens the face at the last moment and picks up a couple wide of third man

lots of elevation but hardly any distance, had no option, tried to loft that over mid-off but ended up skying it and gifting Vettori a comfortable catch, Zaheer was happy to see him go, didn't like being struck for those boundaries
Cooper strikes it well, trying his best to make a match of this one, short outside off and he swatted the poor thing past extra cover
banged it short on the off, swayed out of the way of that one
Cooper frees his arms, was pitched up and there was some width to go with it, smacked it over extra cover for a one bounce four
pitched on a length on the off, chips that towards long-on for a single
low full toss on middle, drives that one back to the bowler
angling in towards middle, defended that into the off side
fires that full outside leg stump, tries to sweep it fine, struck on the pads and they sneak a leg-bye
Binny sensed a chance there, was dragged short by Vettori and he slashed it hard past a diving point for a boundary
comes down the track and chips that inside out over extra cover, lands in front of long-off, two more
flat and short outside off, Binny goes for the cut, can't connect
slower one bowled full, pushed through point into the deep for a single
banged that one short outside off and he opted to leave that one alone, called a wide for height

Bangalore have one hand on this game, slower one from Harshal and Hodge goes after it, swings it hard but doesn't connect well, finds deep square lg in the deep where Agarwal keeps his cool and clasps it firmly
pitched up and it was struck hard, but straight to extra cover, just the single. No, he has chosen not to take it. Wants to take the strike
Hodge is going for it, short on the off, pulls that past midwicket into the deep for a couple more
nicely timed and picked the gap, short and wide and he just guides that past point, and past the diving fielder in the deep, Tiwary, for a boundary
angling in towards middle, Hodge works that one away through square leg for a couple of runs
angles in towards middle, pushed into the off side, a single to the score, Appanna's done
fires it quick on leg stump, tucked away into the leg side for a single
gets on the back foot and stabs that into the off side
pushed away towards point
turns away to go past the outside edge

Appanna's picked up his best haul in T20 cricket, Dravid gave himself too much room there and couldn't do much with it as it turned away from him, played loosely at that one and it took the top edge to land safely in the hands of extra cover
goodish length on the off, defended into the leg side, good stuff from Vettori
punches that one off the back foot through midwicket into the deep for a single
pushed it full, Dravid's not making contact, tried to drive that over midwicket this time, missed, didn't miss leg stump by much
swings and misses, gives himself room and he misses, tries to have that over midwicket
shortish on the off, dabbed it towards point for a quick single
ooh, missed everything, Dravid was beaten through the gate and AB didn't collect, a single to the score
lunges forward and drives that wide of long-off but a single is all they'll get
gone, was pitched up outside off and he slof-swept that straight into the hands of Agarwal at deep midwicket, didn't have enough behind it did Goswami
down the leg side, went for the sweep, missed and so did the keeper
tossed up and Dravid continues to find gaps, landed in the slot and he swung it between long-on and deep midwicket
flat, bowled short outside off, makes room to cut, mistimes it, no run there
tossed up on middle, drives that one down to long-on for a single

stumped, Owais had made his mind up, gave that a bit of air, just a bit, not too much, Owais charged out of his crease and tried to slog that wildly, it turned away to beat the swing of the bat and AB was alert behind the stumps
Dravid reaches his half-century in style, saw some width again, gave himself some space and punched that hard through extra cover, that's been his preferred area today
short on middle and leg, moved across again to pull it through square, don't know what Harshal was appealing for, pitched outside leg, those can't be given
round the wicket and Harshal digs that short outside off, Owais fails to make contact as he tries to slash that over point, quicker than he expected
that's what Rajasthan need, beautifully picked up by Owais, was on a length outside off and he got across to flick it cleanly over the deep square leg boundary
pitched up on middle, makes room and drives that down to long-off for a single
short ball on the off, Owais moves across and mistimes a pull past square leg, a single
classical Dravid, lovely hit, saw some width, came down the crease and just eased it over extra cover, lovely timing and it earned him a one bounce four
saw him coming down the track and he bowled it flat and wide, Owais slapped it to long-off, just the single
Owais had already made room, Appanna kept it tight, got it to turn away sharply and beat Owais as he tried to open the face
comes down the track and chips that towards long-on for a single
gave that one some flight, swung wide of long-on for a couple of runs
flat again from Appanna, shortish outside off, turns away, chopped towards cover
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and just works it to midwicket
on a good length, makes room and squeezes that towards extra cover, just the single
short and Dravid, who'd made room to that one, reached for it and just dragged it back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, defended past the bowler for a single
angling in towards middle, gets on the back foot and turns that one away to midwicket
angling in towards middle, gets on the back foot and pushes it down to the bowler
leading edge, that one was slower through the air, landed outside leg and turned in, Owais closed the face too early, it fell short of extra cover and they picked a single
sees him coming down and keeps that flat as well, Owais defends it into the off side
gets front and across to that one, Appanna keeping it flat, was defended into the off side
spun away, flat outside off, short of a good length and it shot away, Owais withdrew from that one
Rahane holes out, Bangalore have struck, flat and short and it's been struck hard but didn't get the elevation he would have liked, Pomersback was at long-on and he judged it well
comes down the track to that flat delivery and knocks it down into the off side
slightly short on the off, punched down to long-off for one more
works that one through midwicket for a couple of runs, pushing along are Rajasthan
drives that one down towards long-on for a single
tossed up on middle, drives it through midwicket for a single
some away turn there, gets forward and defends it into the off side
Vettori bowls that short outside off, moves back and whacks that through extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
mistimed but lucky, lands safely short of Zaheer at mid-off, came onto him quicker than he expected, went for the pull and he miscued it
slightly short on the off, rocks on the back foot and punches it straight to Vettori, who makes no mistake this time

mis-field at mid-on, Vettori's the man, attacked the ball but over-ran it and let it through, it had enough on it to roll over the ropes, some of Rajasthan's poor fielding form rubbing off on Vettori there
there is a deep midwicket in place and he plays it straight to him, slower one bowled short and that was dragged in the deep for a single
full toss and that's been dispatched, again made a bit of room and just punched it between mid-off and extra cover
opens up, that was bowled short and he had made his mind up, moved away and shovelled it over midwicket
pitched up outside off, driven straight towards long-off for one more to keep strike, tidy start from Vettori
full toss on the off, pushed through to long-off for a single
bowls that one full on the off stump, driven towards long-off for a single
shortish on the off, punched towards long-off for a single
angling in towards middle and leg, turned towards square leg
comes round the wicket, bowls it flat on the off stump, pushed towards cover
short of a good length, made some room to force that through the off side but didn't time it well, straight to extra cover
shortish, comes down the track in an attempt to try to clear it over mid-on, mistimes it but it lands safely, short of the fielder
punched off the back foot into the off side
presses that one away for a couple of runs

appeal for lbw, played across the line and that struck him in line with middle and leg, the umpire appeared to raise his hand only half-way, perhaps trying to indicate it may have been going down leg, close call
short of a good length outside off, cut towards point, think of a single but an overthrow gives them that
angling in towards middle, gets across and flicks that over square leg for a single
gets forward, just a tad wide of off this time, it's defended solidly towards point
short of a good length and he beats third man, chased that one and cut that past point to earn a boundary
pushes that one firmly down towards mid-on for a single
Zaheer comes round the wicket, that's short of a good length on middle and leg, turned towards short fine leg
short of a good length, stabbed it between mid-off and extra cover for a single

short outside off, comes down the track and swats that to mid-off but there's more to the single, it results in overthrows, five runs in all, as it's hurled towards the striker's end. Luke Pomersbach, the substitute fielder, was the guilty party there
angling in towards middle, moved across and pushed it firmly towards mid-on
came on well and he cracked it hard but struck it straight to extra cover, nicely hit but couldn't beat the in-field
goodish length on the off, gets forward and punches that towards extra cover, middled but straight to the fielder
bowled that short on the off and it's been pulled, rocks back and gets it through midwicket for a boundary
just fell short, scooped off the back foot towards point, Dilshan dives forward but it lands just in front of him, they pinch a single
nicely driven, pitched up on the off and he meets that with a full face, drives it down the pitch, mid-off cuts that off, just the single
sliding down the leg side again, called a wide
in the channel outside off stump and he shoulders arms to that one
short of a good length on the pads, tried to work that behind square, struck high on the pads
uppish but he gets it past point, came down the track and got a thick outside edge as he tried to whip that, flew past point to the boundary
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and pushes that to extra cover
well wide down the leg side and AB does a fine job, diving to his left to pluck that one
bowled on a good length outside off, pushes that firmly towards mid-off off the front foot
